instructions.instruction: Use blocks init <name> --yes --language node to scaffold a Node.js/TypeScript agent project non-interactively
instructions.original_snippets: blocks init my-agent --yes --language node
instructions.relevant_when: When creating a new Blocks Network agent project

instructions.instruction: Handler must be a default async export with signature (task: StartTaskMessage, ctx?: TaskContext) => Promise<HandlerResult>
instructions.relevant_when: When implementing any Blocks Network handler

instructions.instruction: Access primary task input via task.requestParts?.[0] and always check for undefined
instructions.original_snippets:
const input = task.requestParts?.[0];
const text = typeof input === 'string' ? input : JSON.stringify(input ?? 'Hello from Blocks Network!');
instructions.relevant_when: When reading user input in a handler function

instructions.instruction: Return { artifacts: [{ data: string|Buffer, mimeType: string, fileName?, outputId? }] } from the handler
instructions.original_snippets: return { artifacts: [{ data: result, mimeType: 'text/plain' }] }; ... type HandlerResult = { artifacts?: ArtifactEntry[] }
instructions.relevant_when: When returning results from a handler function

instructions.instruction: Use ctx?.reportStatus() with optional chaining since ctx may be undefined in testing
instructions.original_snippets: ctx?.reportStatus('Processing...'); ... Always use optional chaining (ctx?.reportStatus()) since ctx may be undefined
instructions.relevant_when: When providing progress updates during task execution

instructions.instruction: Import types from @blocks-network/sdk: StartTaskMessage, TaskContext, HandlerResult
instructions.original_snippets: import type { StartTaskMessage, TaskContext, HandlerResult } from '@blocks-network/sdk';
instructions.relevant_when: When writing the import section of handler.ts

instructions.instruction: Configure agent-card.json with capabilities.taskKinds and required identity, tags, and runtime sections
instructions.original_snippets: "capabilities": { "taskKinds": ["request"] }
instructions.relevant_when: When configuring agent-card.json

instructions.instruction: Set identity.agentName in agent-card.json to match the agent name used in channels
instructions.original_snippets: "identity": { "agentName": "my-agent", "displayName": "My Agent", "description": "...", "version": "1.0.0" }
instructions.relevant_when: When configuring agent-card.json runtime section

instructions.instruction: Trigger agents using TaskClient.create() with billingMode and apiKey, then client.sendMessage({ agentName, requestParts })
instructions.original_snippets:
const client = await TaskClient.create({ billingMode: 'free', apiKey: process.env.BLOCKS_API_KEY! });
const session = await client.sendMessage({ agentName, requestParts: [textPart('Hello')] });
instructions.relevant_when: When writing a trigger script to send tasks to an agent

instructions.instruction: Use session.waitForTerminal() to block until the task completes, then list/download artifacts
instructions.original_snippets:
const terminal = await session.waitForTerminal(60_000);
const artifacts = session.listArtifacts();
instructions.relevant_when: When writing a trigger script to monitor agent responses

instructions.instruction: Use blocks run to start the agent locally, which reads agent-card.json and imports the handler
instructions.original_snippets: blocks run ... Reads agent-card.json from current directory
instructions.relevant_when: When testing an agent locally

instructions.instruction: Deploy agents locally with npm install && npm start (blocks run), or containerize with the scaffolded Dockerfile
instructions.original_snippets: cd my-agent && npm install && npm start
instructions.relevant_when: When deploying an agent

instructions.instruction: Artifacts under 16 KB are inlined as base64; larger artifacts are uploaded to Blocks Files
instructions.original_snippets: Inline (< 16 KB): Base64-encoded in message ... File (>= 16 KB): Uploaded to Blocks Files, returns fileId + fileUrl
instructions.relevant_when: When working with large handler results or file artifacts

instructions.instruction: Use ctx.createStream() for real-time streaming output with write() and end() methods
instructions.original_snippets: const stream = ctx.createStream({ bundleSizeBytes: 2048, maxLatencyMs: 50 }); stream.write('chunk'); await stream.end();
instructions.relevant_when: When implementing streaming output from an agent

instructions.instruction: Use ctx.taskClient.sendMessage() for agent-to-agent communication
instructions.original_snippets: const result = await ctx.taskClient.sendMessage({ agentName: 'another-agent', ownerId: task.ownerId, requestParts: [...] });
instructions.relevant_when: When delegating work to another agent

instructions.instruction: Check ctx.isCancelled or listen to ctx.cancelSignal for graceful task cancellation
instructions.original_snippets: if (ctx.isCancelled) { return { artifact: 'Task cancelled', mimeType: 'text/plain' }; }
instructions.relevant_when: When implementing long-running tasks that should support cancellation

instructions.instruction: Blocks keys fall back to demo keys if not set in .env — no keys required for local development
instructions.original_snippets: # Blocks keys (optional — falls back to demo keys)
instructions.relevant_when: When setting up environment configuration

instructions.instruction: Never hardcode secret keys in client-side trigger scripts
instructions.original_snippets: Never hardcode secret keys in client-side trigger scripts
instructions.relevant_when: When writing trigger scripts or client-side code

instructions.instruction: Include complete handler.ts, agent-card.json, trigger script, and .env.example in deliverables
instructions.original_snippets:
When providing implementations:
1. Include complete handler.ts with proper imports and types
2. Include agent-card.json with correct runtime configuration
3. Provide a trigger script
4. Show .env.example
5. Include instructions for blocks run
instructions.relevant_when: When delivering any Blocks Network implementation

instructions.instruction: Set package.json type to module and include @blocks-network/sdk and tsx as dependencies
instructions.original_snippets: "type": "module" ... "dependencies": { "@blocks-network/sdk": "^0.1.0", "tsx": "^4.15.7" }
instructions.relevant_when: When configuring package.json for a Blocks Network project
